Artificial intelligence (AI) refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines programmed to think and learn like humans. The field of AI research was founded at a workshop at Dartmouth College in 1956. Since then, AI has evolved through multiple phases, from early rule-based systems to modern deep learning approaches that power applications like ChatGPT, image recognition systems, and autonomous vehicles. Today, AI is transforming industries including healthcare, finance, education, and transportation.
